note: BCP/1 custody packages use SIGHASH_DEFAULT (0), equivalent to ALL. ANYONECANPAY and other non-DEFAULT sighash types must not finalize. Canonical P2MR witness is exactly [signature, leaf_script, control_block]; an extra witness item must fail closed (VerifyScript / CLEANSTACK / finalizeexternalsign).

cases.note: SIGHASH_ANYONECANPAY (0x80) is not SIGHASH_DEFAULT. Custody packages reject ANYONECANPAY.
0x81 is a defined Schnorr hashtype but not DEFAULT. PackageReadyToBroadcast / finalizeexternalsign must reject it.
Any non-DEFAULT sighash (NONE, SINGLE, or ANYONECANPAY combinations) must not finalize a BCP/1 package.
An extra witness stack item besides [signature, leaf_script, control_block] is non-canonical and must be rejected.
